settings.title: Settings
settings.requireHardwareAttestationDesc: Only permit registration of physical security keys (reject software and browser passkeys).
settings.deviceTrustDesc: Restrict access to devices running allowed operating systems and browser versions.
settings.deviceTrustBlockMobileDesc: Reject sign-ins from iOS, Android, or other mobile platforms.
settings.riskBasedAuthDesc: Enforce dynamic security policies (adaptive MFA or complete blocks) based on impossible travel, new devices, suspicious hours, and failed attempts.
settings.riskThresholdMfaDesc: Force Step-up MFA verification if the computed risk score meets or exceeds this value.
settings.riskThresholdBlockDesc: Block access entirely if the computed risk score meets or exceeds this value.
settings.ipAllowlistDesc: Restrict logins to these IP addresses or CIDR ranges. Leave empty to allow all IPs. One entry per line or comma-separated.
settings.ipAllowlistHint: Docker tip: include your Docker subnet (e.g. 172.18.0.0/16). Empty = no restriction.
settings.countryAllowlistDesc: Restrict logins to these countries only. Leave empty to allow all countries. Private and Docker IPs always bypass this check. Requires a MaxMind GeoIP database.
settings.countryAllowlistHint: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, comma-separated (e.g. TR, US, DE). Empty = no restriction.
settings.webhookAlertsDesc: Dispatch instant Slack or Mattermost notification alerts when critical security events occur.
settings.webhookTestFailed: Delivery failed. Check the URL and try again.
settings.webhookTestNoUrl: Enter and save a webhook URL first.
settings.sessionTimeoutsDesc: How long users and admins can remain idle before being warned and logged out.
settings.maxSessionsDesc: Maximum number of active sessions allowed per user account (1–20). Oldest sessions are evicted when the limit is reached.
settings.passwordComplexityDesc: Required complexity rule for new passwords.
settings.passwordComplexityStrong: Strong (Min 8 chars, mixed case, digit & symbol)
settings.globalMfaRequiredDesc: Enforce 2FA setup and verification for all user logins.
settings.maxLoginAttemptsDesc: Number of failed attempts allowed before temporary lockout (1–20).
